name: jeeves
description: Your Claude Code, a little wiser with every session: /jeeves:update turns what your sessions and every device's memories teach into global and project CLAUDE.md rules, and shares CLAUDE.md, agents, commands and skills across your devices through a git repo of your own, with a snapshot at every session start and after each edit to the global CLAUDE.md; memories (and, if you turn it on, settings) are backed up per device

data_repo.title: Data repo
data_repo.description: Folder for the git repo that holds your preferences (home/ and hosts/) on this machine. Keep the default unless you already have it elsewhere; /jeeves:setup clones or creates it there.
